page.layout: One page of running text in one column. Margin notes on the left, beside the lines "Amasi inter Occonem" and "ra eum adegit". Page number and running head at the top.
page.running_head: De Agro Frif?. inter Lavic?. & Amaf.

main_text.p: cam, item idem, & omnes socii in agro vicino cum Octapagicis Transflavicanis anno M. cccc. xxv i. de coercendis furibus pacta iniere. Deinde hæc ad Orientem Tumultus bellici cis ultraque Amasum.Amasi inter Occonem & Focconem dissensione enatâ, atque armis commotis, cum Occonis fortuna labasceret, Focco Groninganis succensens Occoni fœderi junctis, trajecto cum suis Amaso, & excitata illic factione sua, prælio Groninganos vicit; victorque in patriam reversus Occonem in pugna cepit: iterumque primo vere anni M.cccc.xxv i i i. Amaso transmisso, aspirante undique fortuna, totum penè agrum, qui inter Amasum & Lavicam est, à civitate avertit, & in novas leges ac nova fœdera eum adegit. Sed Fœdus renovatū.Medachiorum,Hummerziorum, Langowoldiorum, Fredowoldiorum multi non assensêre, & fœdus etiam cum Groninganis, finito jam fœdere priore, pro libertate & legibus priscis rursum pepigêre, in quo appellatio ad Hovetmannos urbanos à judicibus cæteris in agro litigantibus permissa, & ut conventus juridici quatuor quotannis agantur in urbe,

page.notes: Running head and the abbreviations "Frif." and "Lavic." are uncertain; the scan is faint at the head. The note "Fœdus renovatū." is printed as two lines and is set here as one note. The printed headline shows a "Tumultus / bellici cis / ultraque / Amasum." marginal note, transcribed as one. The bottom-right faint watermark and the vertical rule at the right edge are not printed text and are left out.
